title: Software Engineer - Core Java, AI
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
**So, what's the role all about?**
You will join NiCE's CX engineering organization and help build cloud-native, enterprise-grade products. You will work in an agentic software development lifecycle, where engineers and AI agents together design, build, test, review and ship. You will not just implement tickets: you will use AI to move faster, raise quality, and rethink how software is built.
  
  
**How will you make an impact?**

* Use AI as part of every step of your work: turn requirements into specs, generate and refactor code, write tests, review changes, and troubleshoot issues
* Design, build and deliver enterprise-grade backend features in Java/J2EE that perform, scale and integrate into a broad enterprise ecosystem, running on AWS or on-prem
* Understand business requirements and translate them into technical designs; implement business and technical logic in backend code, including REST/SOAP web services and integrations with third-party systems such as caching and message brokers
* Ramp up quickly on unfamiliar codebases and technologies, with AI as your accelerator
* Handle edge cases, error handling, performance, scalability and security before users find them, and analyze and fix defects quickly
* Help shape our agentic development lifecycle as it evolves: explore new AI tools, agents and automations, bring what works into how the team plans, builds, tests and releases, and share it with the team
* Collaborate with Product Management, Architects and Operations, build positive working relationships across teams, and take high accountability for delivering planned work

**Have you got what it takes?**

* B.Sc. / B.E. / B.Tech. in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed institute, or a comparable track record of building real software
* 2+ - 5 years of recent hands-on experience in Java technologies
* AI-first mindset (core requirement): daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools and agents; ability to show concrete examples of results you delivered faster or better with AI; good judgment about when not to trust AI output; curiosity to keep experimenting
* Strong Java fundamentals: Core Java, J2EE ecosystem, algorithms, data structures, OO design and design patterns, with strong coding and defect-analysis skills
* Hands-on experience with Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate and Tomcat, building web services using REST / SOAP, and SQL database development
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, good communication (oral and written), time management, teamwork and fluent English

**You will have an advantage if you also have:**

* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
* Familiarity with public cloud platforms such as AWS (preferred), Google Cloud or Azure
* Experience working with and integrating third-party systems such as caching systems and message brokers
* Experience with agentic development workflows: spec-driven development, MCP servers, prompt engineering, RAG
* Public evidence of your AI-first work: demos, repos, side projects or a GitHub portfolio
* Experience working on Windows and Linux platforms, and with repository tools such as Git/Bitbucket or SVN

**What’s in it for you?**
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
  
  
**Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!**
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
  
  
**Requisition ID: 12059**
**Reporting into:**
Tech Manager
  
  
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor
  
  
**About NiCE**
*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*
*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.*
*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

title: Senior Product Data Analyst
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
  
  
Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
  
  
PTC's product portfolio powers innovation across thousands of global enterprises. To better serve our customers and drive data-informed product decisions, we are building a comprehensive analytics and insights program centered on a deep understanding of how our products are used across the entire portfolio. This requires a robust data pipeline, governed analytics infrastructure, and compelling visual dashboards that empower Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Marketing and Executive Leadership to make data-driven decisions faster.
  
  
The Senior Product Data Analyst is the analytical backbone of this initiative. In this role, you will build and maintain the end-to-end data pipeline that transforms product usage and telemetry data from across PTC's products into trusted, governed analytics products. You will work across the entire stack — from SQL data extraction and Python-based enrichment, to data analysis and visualization in Power BI and Qlik. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Product Management, and business stakeholders to ensure our analytics infrastructure scales with our product and business needs and delivers insights that drive retention, expansion, and product innovation across the portfolio.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Analytics & Analysis**

* Perform in-depth analysis of product usage and customer behavior data across PTC's product portfolio to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
* Apply statistical and analytical techniques to develop KPIs and metrics that quantify adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion.
* Investigate anomalies and shifts in usage data, partnering with Product Management and R&D to understand root causes and recommend action.
* Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Data Visualization (Power BI & Qlik)**

* Design and build dashboards in Power BI and Qlik that visualize product usage, feature adoption, customer engagement, and performance metrics across PTC's product portfolio.
* Create interactive reports with slicers, filters, and drill-through capabilities that enable stakeholders to explore data by customer, product, module, geography, and time period.
* Develop DAX measures (Power BI) and equivalent calculated expressions (Qlik) to support complex business metrics such as adoption rates, retention signals, expansion indicators, and usage-based insights.
* Establish relationships between data sources (product usage/telemetry, customer master data, ARR) and maintain data model integrity as new products and data domains are integrated.
* Optimize dashboard performance for user experience and implement best practices for visual design, accessibility, and consistent styling across the analytics portfolio.

**Data Pipeline Development & Maintenance**

* Design complex SQL queries that access or transform product usage and telemetry data from across PTC's product portfolio, using PTC's data platform (PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or similar).
* Develop data transformations, data tests, and jinja macros in our dbt data environment.
* Develop software engineering best practices, including version control, code hygiene tools, code review, etc.
* Implement data governance best practices within the pipeline: naming conventions, lineage tracking, quality thresholds, and metadata documentation.
* Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot failures, and optimize query efficiency to ensure timely data delivery and minimize infrastructure costs.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Data Engineering to design scalable data architectures and optimize extract-transform-load (ETL) processes.
* Collaborate with Product Management across multiple product lines to define minimum-viable telemetry schemas and acceptance criteria for new feature instrumentation.
* Partner with Finance on commercial analytics use cases, including subscription metrics, license compliance tracking, and usage-based pricing insights.
* Support Sales Operations and Customer Success with insights on customer health, feature adoption, and expansion opportunities across the portfolio.

**Qualifications And Attributes**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in data analytics, data analysis, BI development, or product analytics roles.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL: ability to write complex queries, optimize for performance, and profile data directly to validate correctness and completeness.
* Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, transformation, and enrichment; experience with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Polars.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI and Qlik, including measure/expression development, data model design, and performance optimization.
* Strong data analysis and statistical skills, with the ability to translate raw usage data into clear trends, patterns, and business insights.
* Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift.
* Working knowledge of data governance concepts: data ownership, business glossaries, data quality frameworks, metadata management, and lineage tracking.
* Experience with product telemetry and instrumentation, including event schema design, customer-journey tracking, and partnering with engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling and semantic layer design for consistent metrics and dimensions across dashboards.
* Excellent written communication: ability to document data definitions, requirements, and insights clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to manage projects independently across multiple product lines, prioritize competing demands, and deliver high-quality work on schedule.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with one or more PTC product domains (e.g., PLM, ALM, CAD, or SLM) and their usage patterns, without requiring deep expertise in any single product.
* Familiarity with data governance and metadata management tools (Collibra, Alation, Atlan, or similar).
* Experience supporting commercial analytics use cases: customer retention analysis, expansion/upsell identification, license compliance, usage-based pricing, or revenue operations.
* Knowledge of change management and data literacy programs; experience enabling non-technical stakeholders to use analytics effectively.
* Exposure to software development and CI/CD practices; understanding of how product telemetry is instrumented and deployed.
* Experience with Git version control and collaborative development practices for analytics code.
* Background preparing data for AI/ML consumption, including data validation, feature engineering, and documentation for data science teams.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, self-directed professional who takes ownership of product analytics across PTC's portfolio from end to end. They are comfortable working with ambiguity when requirements are still evolving, asking clarifying questions to understand business context, and making sound technical decisions within constraints. They move easily between writing a SQL query, building a Power BI or Qlik visualization, and explaining a dashboard finding to a non-technical stakeholder. They take pride in data quality and are disciplined about documentation, knowing that well-maintained systems scale better and are more trustworthy. They thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy partnering across teams and product lines to solve hard problems, and measure success by the impact and adoption of the analytics they deliver.
  
  
We are also open to candidates who are earlier in their analytics or BI careers and looking to take the next step into a role with broader ownership across a multi-product portfolio. The right candidate will demonstrate strong analytical judgment, technical depth, excellent organizational and communication skills, and a desire to grow in a dynamic, fast-paced global organization.
  
  
Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
  
  
If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

title: HR Data & Reporting Specialist
description:

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Workday Data & Reporting Analyst will provide hands-on Workday data, reporting and operational support during the separation of The Magnum Ice Cream Company from Unilever and the subsequent transition and stabilization period.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role and will focus on HR data quality, Workday reporting, EIBs, Supervisory Organizations and operational support, ensuring accurate, reliable and timely HR data across the organization.
  
  
The role will independently investigate and resolve complex data and reporting issues, manage ServiceNow tickets, and coordinate with AMS and third-party Workday partners to ensure issues are effectively resolved.
  
  
This role will suit someone who combines strong Workday data and reporting expertise with a hands-on operational mindset and an interest in using automation, AI and emerging Workday capabilities to improve how HR services are delivered.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Workday Data & Data Quality
  
  

* Maintain high-quality Workday Core HCM data, ensuring accuracy, completeness and consistency.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation and quality checks to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Create, execute and validate Workday EIBs and mass data changes, with appropriate pre-load and post-load controls.
* Create and maintain Supervisory Organizations and validate related organizational data.
* Investigate complex data discrepancies, identify root causes and drive corrective actions through to resolution.
* Develop data-quality controls and identify opportunities to prevent recurring issues.
* Ensure HR data changes comply with agreed data governance, approval and documentation standards.

Reporting & Analytics
  
  

* Create and maintain Workday Advanced Reports, dashboards and recurring or ad hoc reporting solutions.
* Translate business requirements into effective reporting solutions.
* Analyze HR data to identify trends, exceptions and data-quality issues.
* Support stakeholders in understanding and effectively using HR data.
* Troubleshoot and resolve reporting issues.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, automate and simplify reporting and data processes.

ServiceNow & Operational Support
  
  

* Manage Workday data and reporting tickets through ServiceNow (SNOW) from triage through resolution and closure.
* Provide hands-on investigation and data correction rather than acting solely as an escalation point.
* Manage priorities and ticket workloads in line with agreed service levels.
* Identify recurring ticket themes and recommend permanent fixes, controls or knowledge articles.
* Collaborate with HR Operations, Payroll, Finance and Technology teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

AMS & Third-Party Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate with AMS and third-party Workday support partners to resolve data and reporting issues.
* Ensure requirements and expected outcomes are clearly defined when work is assigned to external partners.
* Monitor ticket progress, SLAs, escalations and quality of resolution.
* Review and challenge proposed solutions where needed to ensure the underlying issue is resolved.
* Support effective knowledge transfer from external partners to the internal team.
* Identify opportunities to improve the support model and reduce recurring issues or unnecessary external dependency.

Knowledge & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, process documentation and user guidance.
* Provide practical guidance on Workday reporting, EIBs, mass data changes and organizational data.
* Use data-quality findings and recurring ticket themes to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and automation.
* Act as a Workday data and reporting subject-matter expert within a globally distributed team.
* Coach team members and transfer knowledge to strengthen internal Workday data and reporting capability.
* Explore opportunities to use AI, automation and emerging Workday capabilities to improve data management, reporting and operational support.

Experience & Technical Expertise
  
  
**Essential**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Workday, HRIS, HR data, reporting or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of Workday Core HCM data and HR organizational structures.
* Strong experience with Workday EIBs, mass data changes, data validation and reconciliation.
* Experience creating and maintaining Supervisory Organizations.
* Strong Workday reporting capability, including building and maintaining Advanced Reports.
* Strong understanding of HR data quality, controls and governance.
* Experience working within an operational support environment and managing incidents or service requests through ServiceNow (SNOW) or a comparable platform.
* Experience working with AMS and/or third-party Workday support providers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to data accuracy.
* Ability to independently manage complex activities, ticket workloads and competing priorities.
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills.
* A hands-on mindset and willingness to investigate and resolve issues directly.
* Professional fluency in English.

Highly Desirable
  
  

* Experience coordinating or managing an AMS / third-party Workday support model, including tickets, SLAs and escalations.
* Experience in a global Workday production-support environment.
* Experience with Workday Prism Analytics.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau or similar analytics tools.
* Experience supporting major HR transformation, separation, migration or stabilization activities.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Knowledge or experience with Workday Extend.
* Knowledge of AI agents, agentic AI or AI-enabled HR solutions, particularly their application to HR data, reporting or service delivery.
* Experience with VNDLY or Workday Adaptive
* Awareness of broader Workday capabilities, including integrations and security dependencies.

**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Your Responsibilities
  
  

* Demand Forecasting & Advanced Analytics
* Develop, maintain, and improve statistical forecasting and machine-learning models for demand planning.
* Integrate statistical forecasts with market intelligence, customer information, commercial input, promotions, and business assumptions.
* Analyze historical demand, trends, seasonality, outliers, demand variability, and forecast bias.
* Identify the key drivers influencing demand and quantify their impact on forecast performance.
* Evaluate and improve forecasting approaches through back-testing, scenario analysis, and model benchmarking.
* Monitor forecast accuracy, forecast value added (FVA), bias, and other relevant planning KPIs.
* Challenge forecast figures from the business, other regions, and intercompany sources using data-driven insights.
* Support the definition and implementation of Make-to-Stock, Make-to-Order, or related supply strategies through analytical recommendations.
* Develop demand scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments to support tactical and strategic decision-making.
* Multi-Source Demand Signal Analysis & Reconciliation
* Provide the analytical basis for combining multiple demand signal types into one coherent base forecast, including contracted/committed volumes, Lead-to-Order (LTO) pipeline volumes, customer-specific forecasts, and material-level statistical forecasts.
* Analyze and quantify the certainty, time horizon, and granularity differences between demand signal types, and provide data-driven recommendations to support the design and calibration of the demand hierarchy/waterfall logic owned by Demand Planning.
* Identify and flag inconsistencies, double-counting, or gaps between top-down (customer/portfolio) and bottom-up (material/SKU) demand layers, and provide analysis to support their resolution.
* Analyze historical LTO pipeline conversion behavior (e.g., conversion rates, typical phase-in timing) to support appropriate probability-weighting of pipeline volumes relative to contracted volumes.
* Analyze historical patterns of how annual/yearly contract volumes split into monthly (or other sub-annual) quantities, to improve the time-phasing accuracy of contracted demand.
* Analyze and document how incoming customer orders consume the statistical/base forecast over time (forecast consumption logic), and identify opportunities to improve its accuracy and transparency.
* Analyze how push-driven (“crop-driven”) business — volume determined by raw material availability/harvest timing rather than pull demand — is incorporated into the forecast, and run dedicated analytics to improve its treatment and accuracy.
* Data Preparation & Quality Management
* Ensure the quality, consistency, and completeness of demand, customer, material, sales, inventory, and supply chain data.
* Perform history cleansing and establish robust processes for identifying and treating outliers, one-off events, stock-outs, and exceptional demand.
* Support the integration of new customers, materials, products, flows, and data sources into IBP and related planning systems.
* Manage and improve statistical forecast parameters, including model selection, aggregation levels, time horizons, and forecast frequencies.
* Monitor data pipelines and investigate data inconsistencies affecting planning outputs.
* Establish standards for data preparation, documentation, version control, and reproducible analysis.
* Business Partnership & Decision Support
* Translate business questions and planning challenges into analytical requirements and practical data science solutions.
* Interface with Sales, Account Management, Business Units, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Controlling, and Operations on forecasting and planning topics.
* Support the analysis of business complaints relating to forecasts and new product introductions.
* Collaborate with Sales and R&D to obtain and validate LTO pipeline data at the appropriate stage of maturity for inclusion in the combined demand forecast.
* Analyze open contract quantities against call-offs and forecast figures in collaboration with Account Managers and business stakeholders.
* Support the development of a single, aligned forecast across Sales, Finance, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer collaboration and create longer-term visibility of customer demand.
* Present analytical findings, assumptions, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships and promote data-driven decision-making across the organization.
* Strategic Planning & Modelling
* Develop future demand projection models to support the five-year planning process.
* Support tactical and strategic demand planning for regional capacity analysis and capacity-related conclusions.
* Perform product and customer lifecycle analysis, including new product introductions, phase-ins/phase-outs, portfolio changes, and monitoring relevant system and master-data changes.
* Support business scenario planning, including demand upside/downside scenarios, supply constraints, customer changes, and market risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement in demand planning and IBP.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and self-service analytical tools for planning and business stakeholders.
* Ensure analytical solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business and IT standards.

**Qualifications**

* Completed degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Applied Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable quantitative field.
* 3–5 years of professional experience in data science, advanced analytics, demand planning, supply chain analytics, forecasting, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in statistical forecasting, time-series analysis, predictive modelling, and trend analysis.
* Practical experience applying machine-learning techniques to business or supply chain problems.
* Strong programming skills in Python or R.
* Good knowledge of SQL and experience working with structured and large-scale datasets.
* Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
* Sound understanding of demand planning, IBP/S&OP, supply chain processes, inventory management, and forecast performance measurement.
* Experience working with ERP, APS, IBP, or planning systems an advantage.

title: Software Engineer – AI
description:
Join us as Software Engineer - AI at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
  
  
To be successful as a Software Engineer - AI, you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* This is a hands-on Software Engineer role responsible for designing, developing and testing features across web UI, mobile and API-based applications.
* The role will work with developers, product colleagues and other engineering teams to understand requirements, design maintainable solutions, review code, investigate defects and support reliable software releases.
* A typical day may include developing responsive React user interfaces, Java and Spring Boot services and REST APIs; reviewing designs and code; creating and executing automated tests; analysing failures; supporting CI/CD execution; and contributing to engineering and release-readiness discussions.
* The role is not directly customer-facing, but it supports the performance, reliability, security and usability of customer-facing digital services.
* Working across varied applications, technologies and delivery teams; building accessible, responsive and maintainable user experiences and secure, testable backend services; diagnosing complex UI, API and environment-related failures; applying asynchronous and concurrent programming safely; implementing effective observability; learning new tools quickly; and balancing hands-on technical delivery with stakeholder communication, risk management and release deadlines.
* The role offers opportunities to modernise customer-facing web applications and Java services, strengthen UI, API and engineering standards, improve automated coverage and CI/CD quality gates, enhance observability and performance, and apply AI-assisted engineering practices.
* The successful colleague will use Claude or an equivalent enterprise-approved AI tool to support tasks such as solution design, code generation and review, test design and automation, failure analysis, documentation and productivity improvement, while following Barclays security, privacy and responsible-AI controls.

**Mandatory Skills Include**

* Strong hands-on React engineering skills, with a sound understanding of JavaScript, JSX, reusable components, state management and React Hooks.
* Strong command of JavaScript concepts including closures, promises, async/await and array methods.
* Proficiency in semantic HTML, modern CSS, CSS Grid, responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility.
* Strong hands-on Core Java engineering skills, with a sound understanding of object-oriented programming principles, collections, exception handling and modern Java development practices.
* Practical experience with Spring and Spring Boot, including inversion of control, dependency injection, transactions, Spring Data JPA and Spring MVC.
* Experience designing, developing and consuming RESTful APIs, with an understanding of API architecture, contracts, versioning, error handling, security and API gateway patterns.
* Experience with Gradle or Maven for dependency management, build automation and integration with delivery pipelines.
* Practical experience with testing frameworks and tools such as Mockito, EasyMock, Pact and Karate, including unit, component, contract and API testing.
* Hands-on experience with multithreading and concurrent programming, including ExecutorService, CompletableFuture and thread-safety techniques.
* Experience implementing application observability using tools such as the ELK Stack, Splunk or AppDynamics, including logging, monitoring, tracing and production-failure analysis.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts.
* Experience integrating build, test and deployment activities with CI/CD pipelines and source-control workflows using Jenkins or GitLab.

**Preferred Skills Include**

* Exposure to React Native and mobile UX engineering.
* Exposure to performance tuning and cloud services on AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with automated UI and mobile testing using tools such as Jest, Appium or Detox.
* Practical experience using Claude or an equivalent enterprise-approved AI assistant for software engineering tasks, alongside clear communication, problem solving and stakeholder collaboration.
* You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in the role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Data Platform Engineer (Full Stack)**
At Johnson Controls, you will help build the data platform behind OpenBlue, our smart-building platform. In this role, you will build the services, APIs, and user interfaces that put trusted building and energy data in the hands of the applications and people who rely on it.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a full-stack Data Platform Engineer with 3+ years of experience to build data-serving APIs, platform tooling, and React front ends on the OpenBlue Data Platform (OBDP). You will work across .NET or Java back-end services and the streaming and lakehouse stack (Kafka, Flink, Spark, Apache Iceberg, and Snowflake) alongside senior engineers. This is a hands-on role where you will own well-scoped features end to end, from UI to data, and take on more design ownership over time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop back-end services and data-serving APIs (REST and GraphQL) in .NET (C#) or Java.
* Build and maintain React and TypeScript front ends for platform tooling, data management, and operational views.
* Integrate services with Kafka, Flink, and Spark pipelines and with Iceberg, Snowflake, and PostgreSQL data stores.
* Write unit, integration, and functional tests and contribute to CI/CD pipelines.
* Fix production defects and support SIT, UAT, and deployments.
* Deploy services on AKS and set up monitoring and alerting for the features you own.

**How You Will Do It**

* Own the outcome with accountability by delivering well-tested features and following through on commitments.
* Stay close to work by understanding how users and downstream applications use the data and tools you build.
* Look for root causes, improve continuously, and raise issues with candor.
* Work as one team by partnering with engineers, QA, UX, and product, sharing context, and asking for help early.
* Use clear documentation and disciplined engineering practices to support consistency and handoffs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in full-stack software engineering.
* Professional experience building front ends with React and TypeScript (or JavaScript), HTML, and CSS.
* Professional back-end experience in .NET (C#) or Java, including REST API design.
* Solid SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
* Working knowledge of data platforms, with exposure to at least one of Kafka, Flink, Spark, Iceberg, or Snowflake, and eagerness to learn the rest.
* Experience with Git, code review, and agile/Jira workflows.
* Hands-on AI-assisted development with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar, with a critical eye for generated code.

**Nice to Have**

* GraphQL API design experience.
* Exposure to Trino, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or HBase.
* Experience with Apache Airflow.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, and Helm.
* Azure experience.
* Experience with time-series or IoT data.
* UI component libraries, design systems, or data visualization libraries.
